items.source: Only if the resource’s current ETag state matches the If-Match header is the operation carried out. This safeguard prevents clients from stomping on each other. Two different clients can fetch the resource and have an identical ETag. If one client updates the resource, it gets a new ETag in the response. But the first client still has the old header. If that client attempts an update with the If-Match header, the update fails because they no longer match. Instead, that client receives an HTTP 412 Precondition Failed message to be sent back. The client can then catch up however is necessary.
items.translation: 仅当资源的当前 `ETag` 状态与 `If-Match` 请求头匹配时，才会执行该操作。此保护机制可防止客户端之间相互覆盖。两个不同的客户端可以获取同一资源并获得相同的 `ETag`。如果其中一个客户端更新了该资源，响应中将返回一个新的 `ETag`。但第一个客户端仍持有旧的请求头。若该客户端尝试使用 `If-Match` 请求头进行更新，由于两者不再匹配，更新将失败；此时服务器会返回 HTTP `412 Precondition Failed` 消息。随后，该客户端可根据需要重新同步数据。

items.translation: 调整PUT/PATCH/DELETE操作以使用If-Match，并处理HTTP412 Precondition Failed状态码。

items.source: The preceding command (by default) runs a GET. Spring Data REST checks for If-None-Match headers while doing a GET. If the header matches the ETag, it concludes that nothing has changed and, instead of sending a copy of the resource, sends back an HTTP 304 Not Modified status code. Semantically, it reads “If this supplied header value does not match the server-side version, send the whole resource. Otherwise, do not send anything.”
items.translation: 上一条命令（默认情况下）执行一个 `GET` 请求。Spring Data REST 在执行 `GET` 时会检查 `If-None-Match` 请求头。如果该头的值与 ETag 匹配，则判定资源未发生变化，因此不会返回资源的副本，而是返回 HTTP `304 Not Modified` 状态码。从语义上讲，这意味着：“如果提供的头值与服务器端版本不匹配，则发送整个资源；否则，不发送任何内容。”

items.source: Adjust GET operations to use If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since and handle HTTP 304 Not Modified status codes.
items.translation: 调整GET操作以使用If-None-Match和If-Modified-Since，并处理HTTP304 Not Modified状态码。

items.source: When fetching resources, also embed self URIs in your DOM nodes (perhaps data-uri or data-self) so that it is easy to go back to the resource.
items.translation: 在获取资源时，也请将 `self` URI 嵌入到您的 DOM 节点中（例如使用 `data-uri` 或 `data-self`），以便轻松返回到该资源。

items.source: The ETag header provides a way to tag resources. This can prevent clients from overriding each other while also making it possible to reduce unnecessary calls.
items.translation: ETag 响应头提供了一种对资源进行标记的方法。这不仅可以防止客户端之间相互覆盖，还可以减少不必要的请求。

items.source: With the preceding command, you are asking that a resource be fetched only if it has changed since the specified time. If so, you get a revised Last-Modified header with which to update the client. If not, you receive an HTTP 304 Not Modified status code.
items.translation: 通过上述命令，您要求仅在资源自指定时间以来发生变化时才获取该资源。如果是这样，您将收到一个修订后的 `Last-Modified` 响应头，用于更新客户端；否则，您将收到 HTTP `304 Not Modified` 状态码。

items.source: HTML5 nicely supports data-* attributes, so store the version in the DOM (somewhere such as an data-etag attribute).
items.translation: HTML5 很好地支持 `data-*` 属性，因此可以将版本信息存储在 DOM 中（例如放在一个 `data-etag` 属性里）。

items.source: Identify the entries that would benefit from tracking the most recent updates. When fetching these resources, store the Last-Modified value in the DOM (data-last-modified perhaps).
items.translation: 识别那些需要跟踪最新更新的条目。在获取这些资源时，将 `Last-Modified` 值存储到 DOM 中（例如使用 `data-last-modified`）。

items.source: By embedding ETag elements and Last-Modified values in your DOM (or perhaps elsewhere for a native mobile app), you can then reduce the consumption of data and battery power by not retrieving the same thing over and over. You can also avoid colliding with other clients and, instead, be alerted when you need to reconcile differences.
items.translation: 通过在您的 DOM（或原生移动应用的其它位置）中嵌入 `ETag` 元素和 `Last-Modified` 值，您可以减少数据消耗和电池电量消耗，避免重复获取相同内容。此外，您还可以避免与其他客户端发生冲突，并在需要协调差异时收到通知。

items.translation: 1 Spring Data Commons 的 @LastModifiedDate 注解支持以多种格式捕获此信息（包括 JodaTime 的 DateTime、旧版 Java 的 Date 和 Calendar、JDK8 日期/时间类型，以及 long/Long）。

items.source: This POJO is from an ETag-based unit test, so it does not have @Entity (JPA) or @Document (MongoDB) annotations, as expected in application code. It focuses solely on how a field with @Version results in an ETag header.
items.translation: 此 POJO 源自基于 ETag 的单元测试，因此正如应用程序代码中预期的那样，它没有 @Entity（JPA）或 @Document（MongoDB）注解。它仅专注于带有 @Version 的字段如何导致生成 ETag 响应头。

items.source: 1 The @Version annotation (the JPA one in case you’re using Spring Data JPA, the Spring Data org.springframework.data.annotation.Version one for all other modules) flags this field as a version marker.
items.translation: 1 @Version 注解（如果您使用的是 Spring Data JPA，则为 JPA 的注解；对于其他模块，则为 Spring Data 的 org.springframework.data.annotation.Version）将该字段标记为版本标识符。

items.source: The term, “version,” may carry different semantics with different data stores and even different semantics within your application. Spring Data REST effectively delegates to the data store’s metamodel to discern if a field is versioned and, if so, only allows the listed updates if ETag elements match.
items.translation: “版本”一词在不同数据存储中可能具有不同的语义，甚至在同一应用程序内部也可能存在不同的含义。Spring Data REST 会委托给数据存储的元模型来判断某个字段是否已启用版本控制；如果是，则仅在 ETag 元素匹配时才允许执行列出的更新操作。

items.source: Do not mix and match header value with different queries. Results could be disastrous. Use the header values ONLY when you request the exact same URI and parameters.
items.translation: 请勿将不同的查询与响应头值混用，否则可能导致灾难性后果。仅在请求完全相同的 URI 和参数时，才使用响应头值。
